sources.snippet: mrnafm huggingface.co mrnafm huggingface.co is an AI model on huggingface.co that provides mrnafm's model effect (), which can be used instantly with this multimolecule mrnafm model. huggingface.co supports a free trial of the mrnafm model, and also provides paid use of the mrnafm. Support call mrnafm model through api, including Node.js, Python, http.
